My first YouTube channel

leopardbookshop

When I was learning Lua, at 10, I made tutorials showing people how to build things in Roblox Studio.

Go to the channel

My old YouTube channel

Most of the videos show how to make common Roblox game features using Lua. It was great knowing I had a good enough grasp of the language to teach it.

I don’t upload there anymore, although I later made a few Python videos too. By the time I stopped, the channel had reached just over 400 subscribers and 108,000 views. I sound about two years old in nearly all of the videos.

It's still all there

An archive of my earliest programming

It's not exactly flattering but I've kept the channel online and it still gathers views.

Also, I still receive quite a few comments asking for advice, which I try to reply to.
